description.value: Valhalla Pines is a six-acre forested campground near Vallican in the Slocan Valley, offering private huts, RV sites, and tent sites set among fir and pine forest with mountain and river surroundings. Host Tom is a local guide who provides hands-on recommendations for cycling, hiking, swimming holes, and paddling the Slocan River, making it a natural base for Kootenay adventure. The campground sits on the Frog Peak Loop route with no cell coverage on the approach road but excellent on-site Wi-Fi, giving it a genuinely off-grid character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides comprehensive amenity detail across multiple subpages. The front page and /amenities/ subpage explicitly confirm flush toilets, free hot showers, potable water (water hydrant in gallery; water listed for sites), rain-sheltered picnic tables and community building as covered shelter, electrical power at the community building and sites, ice available for a fee, and an online booking calendar. Recent Hipcamp and Google reviews from August–September 2025 confirm the campground is actively operating. OSM had no phone, address, or amenity tags, so all factual claims derive from the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Slocan Park' but the website address states 'Vallican' — both are Slocan Valley communities; website address used as authoritative.
OSM record has no osm_id, phone, or address tags; all contact information sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating campground with verified 2025 guest reviews and live online booking; directly on the Frog Peak Loop route and well-suited as a touring cyclist base.
enrichment_extras.notes: Bicycle rentals and guided bike or hike tours available for an extra fee. Host Tom actively assists guests with local cycling and paddling route planning. No cell coverage on most of Route 6 approaching the campground; free Wi-Fi available on-site.

wow_evidence: sits on the Frog Peak Loop route … local guide who provides hands-on recommendations for cycling
